newsitem.title: USA: Ohio woman gives birth after 102-day labor.
newsitem.headline: Ohio woman gives birth after 102-day labor.

text.p: Twins born after a medically-delayed labour of 102 days following the death of a triplet were in good condition on Friday, along with their mother, a hospital reported.

"The twins are doing great and the doctors are ecstatic," Jeff Blunt, media coordinator for Good Samaritan Hospital, said. He said Jennifer Furber, 28, of Hebron, Kentucky, was recovering well and would be sent home on Sunday.
The twins, a boy and a girl, will join her in a couple of weeks. She gave birth to Christopher and Jahnae on Thursday.

Eighteen weeks into her pregnancy with triplets she was diagnosed with a condition that caused premature labour and cervix dialation. One of the triplets died at that point and doctors doubted the other two would survive, but they closed her cervix surgically and gave her anti-labour drugs.
She spent 11 weeks in the hospital and the rest of the time at home confined to bed. A medical expert said it was one of the longest labours in recorded medical history.
